description: Pie, donut and sunburst charts: innerRadius turns the pie into a donut, dataLabels placement outside draws callout labels on leader lines that never overlap, topN on rowsToChartSpec folds small slices into Other, a slice click selects it and the grid follows, a legend click hides a slice and the shares recompute, and specToTreemap on a split spec builds a sunburst that drills down on click. Free, in @svgrid/grid.

faq.question: How do I turn a pie into a donut?
faq.answer: Set innerRadius on the spec, a fraction of the radius from 0 to about 0.85. Anything above zero is a donut.

faq.question: How do I put the labels outside the slices?
faq.answer: Set dataLabels: { placement: outside }. The labels sit on leader lines and are pushed apart so they do not overlap; placement inside writes the share on the slice instead.

faq.question: How do I group small slices into Other?
faq.answer: Pass topN to rowsToChartSpec. Everything past the top N is summed into one Other category, named by otherLabel.
